Once upon a time Granny and Grandpa lived in a little house at the edge of a wood.
They had no children, and they were often lonely.
One morning Granny made a gingerbread man.
She gave him two raisin eyes, a smiling mouth and three candy buttons.
Then she laid him on a tray by the window.
After a while Granny came back to the tray.
Up jumped the Gingerbread Man, and he ran across the kitchen floor.
Stop!
Granny said.
Come back here!
Run, run, as fast as you can,
Gingerbread Man said.
You can't catch me, I'm the Gingerbread Man!
Granny and Grandpa ran after him, but they could not catch him.
The Gingerbread Man ran on until he met a Cow in a green field.
Stop, Gingerbread Man!
Cow said.
Come and play with me!
She swished her tail and set off after him.
I have run away from Granny and Grandpa,
Run, run, as fast as you can.
The Cow ran after him, but she could not catch him.
Next the Gingerbread Man met a Horse by the fence.
Horse said.
I have run away from Granny, Grandpa and a cow,
The Horse galloped after him, but he could not catch him either.
Then the Gingerbread Man came to a river.
He could not swim, and he did not know what to do.
A clever Fox was sitting on the bank.
I will help you,
Fox said in a kind voice.
Jump on my tail and I will carry you across.
Thank you, Fox,
Gingerbread Man said, and he jumped on the Fox's tail.
The water grew deeper.
You are getting wet,
Fox said.
Jump on my back.
Gingerbread Man said, and he jumped on the Fox's back.
The water grew deeper still.
You are too heavy,
Jump on my nose, and you will be safe.
Gingerbread Man said, and he jumped on the Fox's nose.
Fox swam across and set him down on the far bank.
Now go home to Granny and Grandpa,
Fox said with a smile.
They miss you.
So the Gingerbread Man went home, and they all sat together for a bedtime story.
